description: For a sequence A_n with the strong finite intersection property, its least-point diagonal sequence is strictly increasing; b_n belongs to each A_i for i at most n; the range minus A_i is contained in the first i selected points; and the range is an infinite pseudointersection.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint_spec (A : ℕ → Set ℕ)
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.HasStrongFiniteIntersectionProperty (Set.range A)) :
  StrictMono (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint A) ∧
    (∀ (n i : ℕ), i ≤ n → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint A n ∈ A i) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ),
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint A (n + 1) =
            sInf {m | Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint A n < m ∧ ∀ i ≤ n + 1, m ∈ A i}) ∧
        (∀ (i : ℕ),
            Set.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint A) \ A i ⊆
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint A '' Set.Iio i) ∧
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.IsPseudointersection (Set.range A)
            (Set.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.diagonalPoint A))
